lines.name: GNOMEY
lines.text: You came back. Most don't. One-two has a seat. Midnight Rush starts at twelve.

lines.name: TOMMY
lines.subject: tommy
lines.text: Told you, kid. Mayor of this room. I see everything.

lines.name: MUSTICH
lines.subject: mustich
lines.text: Ah, the free-seat lad. Lovely hoodie. Did it come with the seat?

lines.name: MUSTICH
lines.subject: mustich
lines.text: I've had my name on the Classic list for a year. Don't get attached to it.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: Ten thousand. Or the Classic. Whichever comes first.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Goal: win the Biscayne Classic, or build a $10,000 bankroll.

directions.text: sodium light, the list board squeaks, the palms outside going black
